title: GoFundMe Fundraiser Scraper
description: Collect public GoFundMe fundraiser listings by keyword, location, or a full GoFundMe search URL.

url.title: Search URL
url.description: Full GoFundMe search URL, for example https://www.gofundme.com/s/fundraisers?q=medical. Used only when no keyword or location is supplied. A keyword or location always takes precedence over this field.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Search term for fundraiser titles and related text. Takes precedence over the search URL.

location.title: Location
location.description: City, region, or country, or coordinates as lat,lng (for example 40.7128,-74.0060). Takes precedence over the search URL and combines with a keyword when both are supplied.

results_wanted.title: Results wanted
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of fundraiser records to save.

max_pages.title: Max pages
max_pages.description: Maximum number of search result pages to request. Each page holds up to 16 fundraisers.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy setup. Leave disabled for normal runs.
